description: Single source of truth for the model fleets the benchmark + battletest harnesses drive. Named profiles map the three operating modes to concrete targets/models: (a) local-single = one node, one model; (b) local-split = orchestrator and workers on separate nodes; (c) cloud-* = frontier models for apples-to-apples comparison with Claude Code / Codex. Adapters call clio_fleet.load_fleet(); the selected profile defaults to `default` below and is overridable with CLIO_FLEET_PROFILE. The per-node CLIO_* env vars still override url/model/target/thinking per run, and terminal-bench's install-clio.sh renders its container settings.yaml from the same CLIO_* vars. Cloud profiles authenticate through the operator's ~/.config/clio OAuth (anthropic-max / openai-codex) and are pass@k only (frontier decoding is not bit-reproducible).

local-single.description: One node, one model loaded: mini serves both orchestrator and workers.

local-split.description: Orchestrator on mini, workers on dynamo: exercises the full cross-node dispatch path.

cloud-claude.description: Frontier Claude for apples-to-apples comparison with Claude Code. OAuth via anthropic-max; pass@k only.

cloud-openai.description: Frontier OpenAI for apples-to-apples comparison with Codex. OAuth via openai-codex; pass@k only.
